Ali Badra Diabate and Juan were the first to see yellow cards within a two-minute window, signaling the combative nature of the fixture. However, Samsunspor managed to channel that energy positively in the 36th minute. In a well-structured move, Marius Mouandilmadji acted as the architect, providing a precise assist for Tanguy Coulibaly , who made no mistake in putting the hosts ahead before the interval. The defining moment of the game occurred in the 81st minute when Göztepe defender Heliton was shown a straight red card. The dismissal sparked heavy protests from his teammates, but the decision stood, leaving the visitors a man down at a critical juncture. Mouandilmadji Shines in the Late Blitz Capitalizing on their numerical advantage, Samsunspor exploited the opposition's defensive gaps to seal the result. In the 85th minute, Marius Mouandilmadji was decisive once again, this time setting up Elayis Tavsan , who finished clinically to double the lead. Just four minutes later, the roles were reversed: Tavsan turned provider with an assist for Mouandilmadji , who capped off a brilliant individual performance with a goal in the 89th minute. The final whistle confirmed a categorical victory built on resilience and lethal finishing in the dying moments.
